integrity: Proof uses a strong deformation retraction of the genuine geometric orbit space and a simplex-skeleton Morse matching; ten finite quotient-chain profiles checked at four primes as corroboration, not all-parameter proof.
scientific_limitations: Equal-length spider trees only, at least three arms, full arm permutation group; no classification for proper subgroups, unequal arms, or Borel homotopy quotients. Independent validation not performed.
title: Integral homotopy of arm-symmetry quotients of spider general-position complexes
